jess: Quick note: ran an earlypredict sketch on ember-13b-8bit to compare against our current speculative decode. Results look promising latency-wise but weird for long-form quality.
priya: What hardware / batch? single-GPU or dedicated pool?
kai: Also which sampling setup? top-k/top-p/temp?
jess: Single A100-80GB, batch=1, seq=512, temp=0.8. Baseline iterative decode ~52ms/token. earlypredict probe ~36ms/token but we see coherence regressions on long summaries.
kai: Can you paste the run config & quick log?
jess: ```
model: ember-13b-8bit
mode: earlypredict
lookahead: 3
earlypredict_threshold: 0.7
sampling: top_p=0.92,top_k=50
temp: 0.8
batch: 1
seq_len: 512
kv_warmup: true
```
omar: :eyes: Did you run evals or just raw latency traces?
jess: Ran 1k QA prompts + 200 long-form summarization holdouts. QA EM roughly unchanged (±0.5%), but summarization ROUGE-L dropped ~3.2 points vs fp16 baseline.
priya: Hypothesis: earlypredict biases token probs for longer contexts; threshold/lookahead interacts with quant noise. We should sweep lookahead (1,3,5) and threshold (0.6-0.9) and compare fp16 vs 8-bit. I'll queue runs on dedicated.
kai: Also check with KV cache disabled and with truncated warm prefixes — caching could amplify drift.
jess: Command I used: `python run_probe.py --model ember-13b-8bit --mode earlypredict --lookahead 3 --threshold 0.7 --batch 1 --seq 512 --sampling "top_p=0.92,top_k=50"`
devops-bot: Job ep-probe-6188 scheduled on pool-dedicated-2. ETA ~45m.
omar: Add a deterministic run (temp=0.0) to separate sampling variance vs algorithmic drift.
jess: Will add. Also noted quantization seems to make earlypredict more brittle vs fp16 — maybe logits compression hurts confidence estimates.
priya: Plan: run sweep (lookahead 1,3,5) x (threshold 0.6,0.7,0.8) x (fp16,8bit) x (temp 0.0,0.8) on 200 summarization prompts. Capture avg latency/token, ROUGE-L, QA EM. Mark any run with >2 ROUGE drop as regression.
kai: Suggest a per-request fallback: compute token-level perplexity delta; if delta exceeds threshold, disable earlypredict for that request and fallback to baseline decode. We can prototype this in the routing hook.
jess: Good — I'll prototype fallback hook and instrument token_confidence logging.
omar: FYI I hit a similar long-form regression with beamless early-exit last quarter; could be a systemic effect when skipping tokens early under quant noise.
priya: I'll collate results into a sheet. jess, ping this thread with job IDs and summarized numbers when runs finish.
jess: Will do. tl;dr: earlypredict gives ~30% token latency speedup but quality is sensitive to quantization and long-form contexts; require systematic sweep + fallback before rollout.
